name: Content, mission and values
description: A mission statement beside a list of company values with icons.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.default: Make every product decision start with a customer’s own words

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.default: We are 28 people in Toronto and Lisbon building the research tool we wished we had. These four values decide how we hire, what we ship and what we turn down.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: One or two sentences about what this value means in practice.

default.title: Listen before you build
default.text: Every project starts with at least five customer conversations. If we cannot find them, we do not build it.

default.title: Share the raw evidence
default.text: Quotes and clips travel further than opinions. We link the source for every claim we make.

default.title: Protect the people we record
default.text: Recordings hold people’s voices and faces. Consent, privacy and deletion are never an afterthought.

default.title: Stay small and useful
default.text: We would rather do five things well than fifty things halfway. Saying no is part of the job.
